name: Perfect Balance
summary: A daily 3D balance-scale game: stack everyday things until they match the weight on the other pan.
description: You get something on one pan, say an elephant, and a shelf of everyday objects to stack on the other until you think the weights match. Then the scale lets go, and landing between 3% light and 4% heavy wins the round. There are five rounds a day, the same for everyone, and a Freeplay mode. Jolt physics, compiled to WebAssembly, runs in a web worker so the piles slide and topple without the page stuttering, and each of the 200 objects has its weight from two independent sources.

image.alt: A balance scale with a keg of beer on one pan and a stack of televisions on the other.
